title: Product Updates: Sentiment Screens, Insider Sales, SEC Comment Letters, No Hallucination Guarantee + More
summary: Hudson Labs announces the No Hallucination Guarantee – the first of its kind. Plus the addition of tone-based AI search, insider sales tracking, SEC comment letter chat and more.
body_markdown:
We’re excited to announce the formalization of our **No Hallucination Guarantee** – the first of its kind. Read the full policy[here](https://link.hudson-labs.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMzE5NDAsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5odWRzb24tbGFicy5jb20vYmxvZy9uby1oYWxsdWNpbmF0aW9uLWd1YXJhbnRlZSIsInQiOjE3ODE4NzQ3Mzl9/6614cc0ff44ed07c28b137915fa01e7cd49ec0afb05411ed720ca67eea816c59) .


Hudson Labs delivers **error-free, restatement-adjusted numbers** — extracted from any supported document over a 5 year period.


You can now request[long-running agentic research](https://link.hudson-labs.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMzE5NDAsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5odWRzb24tbGFicy5jb20vYmxvZy9pbnRyb2R1Y2luZy1odWRzb24tbGFicy1kZWVwLWRpdmUiLCJ0IjoxNzgxODc0NzM5fQ/df7f89568e75fd5a1a997cc2186226f38a3e1f01885af5e9a0aabe7cc3b84399) through Hudson Labs at a fraction of the cost. Learn more below.


**New to Hudson Labs:**


-


**Insider sales tracking:** Access ownership filings through Co-Analyst chat.


-


**Guidance vs. actuals over time:** Hudson Labs is the only AI for finance that offers **complete management guidance** identification.[Use this prompt](https://link.hudson-labs.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMzE5NDAsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3BsYXRmb3JtLmh1ZHNvbi1sYWJzLmNvbS9jb2FuYWx5c3Qvc2hhcmUvbWdTZDlaa19mMGplaENyUSIsInQiOjE3ODE4NzQ3Mzl9/eb0157a0725d1f5f3a00c4a86b7f86387ce19dbfc315abcd7ba03c1542ff4260) .


-


**Tone-based screening:** Source ideas based on[stress](https://link.hudson-labs.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMzE5NDAsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5odWRzb24tbGFicy5jb20vcmVzZWFyY2gvY2VvLXN0cmVzcy0yMDI2LWFuYWx5c2lzIiwidCI6MTc4MTg3NDczOX0/2dfdef4808dec8bef1c87570745c918c85186f8bbaa24d3c67397cde959927e2) , confidence, deflection, anger or frustration.


-


**SEC commentary summaries:** Ask for SEC comment letters in Co-Analyst chat.


-


**Prompt templates in chat:** Hit “/” to select and run saved prompts using keyboard shortcuts.


-


**SEC exhibits:** Find any exhibit in the “Filings & Transcripts” tab and incorporate into chat.


-


**Microsoft Teams Agents:** Get agent results directly in your Teams channel


-


**Connectors:** OneNote Connector currently available in beta. OneDrive and upload coming soon.


-


**Deep Dive:** Now available in the[research library](https://link.hudson-labs.com/e/c/eyJlIjoxMzE5NDAsImVtYWlsX2lkIjoiZXhhbXBsZSIsImhyZWYiOiJodHRwczovL3BsYXRmb3JtLmh1ZHNvbi1sYWJzLmNvbS9saWJyYXJ5P2NhdGVnb3J5PWRlZXAtZGl2ZSIsInQiOjE3ODE4NzQ3Mzl9/206b7c38be38c37c7ad54e231163783ed07465d07e8248f0c2c8d6ffc24bd519) and by request.


-


**Prospectuses, proxies, 20-Fs + in Market Intelligence:** The Market Intelligence corpus keeps expanding.
